objective: Preallocate fallback column-match buffers during expression column resolution.

tasks.title: Preallocate fallback column matches
tasks.result: Fallback column-name resolution now preallocates the match-index vector from schema column count before preserving the existing ambiguity check.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves exact-name lookup, case-insensitive lookup, suffix fallback matching, and ambiguous-column errors.
